# Atomic Skiing

> > Atomic is a premium ski equipment manufacturer specializing in Hawx ski boots (Ultra, Magna, Prime collections), bindings, and skiing gear with a focus on innovation and sustainability.

Atomic, headquartered in Altenmarkt, Austria, produces high-performance ski equipment including their flagship Hawx boot collections featuring BOA closure systems and GW (GripWalk) compatibility. The site provides product catalogs, boot finders, and company news about their climate action initiatives and freeride team.

## Key Topics

- Hawx Ultra
- Hawx Magna
- Hawx Prime
- BOA closure system
- GripWalk (GW) compatibility
- Shift² 16 MN binding
- Free touring bindings
- Ski boot fitting
- Atomic Freeride team
- Climate action and sustainability
- Altenmarkt, Austria
- Ski equipment innovation
- Boot finder tools
